tests.title: Guest cart is kept when the guest logs in at checkout
tests.goal: A shopper who fills the cart as a guest and logs in to check out does not lose the cart.
preconditions: Logged out; QA member account from .env or created at runtime (SBF-006); the member cart is empty
data: A non-quota product found at runtime

steps.text: As a guest add 2 units of the product to the cart
Open /checkout and choose to log in, then log in as the QA member

expected.text: Step 3: the cart still holds the product with quantity 2 and the member prices/discounts are applied
Nothing is duplicated when the member cart already had items (repeat once with 1 unit already in the member cart: quantities add up or the rule is shown)
